description: Use Delinea Secret Server's privileged secrets in workflows: find and read secrets, store new ones, check them out and in, change and check passwords, see who used them, and manage folders, users and groups. Start workflows when a secret is added, its password changes or a change or heartbeat fails, a secret is checked out, or a folder or user is added or locked out.

delinea_heartbeat_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a secret's heartbeat finds its credentials no longer work, such as Failed, Unable to connect or Account locked out. It runs again after a heartbeat succeeds and a later one fails. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

delinea_user_locked_out_trigger.description: Runs when a Secret Server user is locked out, such as after too many failed sign-ins. It runs again if they are unlocked and locked out again. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.application_account: Whether it is an application account.
output.domain: Their Active Directory domain, blank for a local user.
output.locked_out: Whether the user is locked out.
output.login_failures: How many sign-ins failed in a row.
output.username: The user name they sign in with.
